title: AdirTV - Official Recording
description: The official modpack for AdirTV's YouTube Channel
body:
# 🎮 **The Official Modpack for the AdirTV Minecraft Community**!🎮

📹 Want to be featured in AdirTV’s videos?
Play with the exact modpack Adir uses for recording!
Join the fun, record your adventures, and become part of the content! 🎥✨

## 🛠️ **What’s Inside?**

This lightweight modpack is packed with Quality of Life features and performance optimizations to enhance your gameplay without breaking your FPS!

- 🔊 **Plasmo Voice** – Talk to nearby players in-game with realistic proximity chat
- 🌍 **Distant Horizons** – Explore more! See far beyond the server’s render distance
- 😄 **Chat Heads** – Makes the chat more fun and expressive with player icons
- 🍎 **AppleSkin** – Shows food values, saturation, and more helpful hunger info
- 🎒 And a few other tiny tweaks that make a huge difference in-game!



## 👑 Download now and be part of the AdirTV's videos!
